kb.title: Spa price list
kb.body:
Serene Spa treatment prices
Aromatherapy massage 60 minutes costs Rp 650,000. Couples massage 60 minutes costs Rp 1,200,000 per couple. A foot reflexology session of 30 minutes costs Rp 300,000.

Spa rules
Guests under 16 need a parent in the room. Please tell the therapist about pregnancy, allergies or injuries. Cancel at least 4 hours before the treatment to avoid a charge.

kb.title: Pool and beach rules
kb.body:
Pool rules
The infinity pool is open 07:00 to 20:00. There is no lifeguard on duty at the infinity pool, so children must be supervised. Glass is not allowed in the pool area. Please shower before entering.

Beach
The beach is public. Hotel loungers are free for guests until 18:00. Swimming is safe between the red and yellow flags only. Please do not swim when the red flag is up.

kb.title: Cancellation and refund policy
kb.body:
Room bookings
Flexible rates can be cancelled free of charge up to 48 hours before check-in. After that the first night is charged. Non-refundable rates are not refunded.

Trips and transport
Trips and transfers can be cancelled free up to 24 hours before pickup. Within 24 hours the full price is charged.

Refunds
Refunds go back to the original payment method within 7 to 14 working days.

kb.title: Nearby guide
kb.body:
Money
The nearest ATM is at the Jalan Raya shop, a 5 minute walk. The front desk can change cash at the daily rate.

Health
The nearest pharmacy is Apotek Sehat, 800 metres away, open 08:00 to 22:00. The nearest clinic is Bali Care Clinic, 10 minutes by car. In an emergency dial 0 from your room.

Getting around
A metered taxi to the airport takes about 45 minutes. Please ask the front desk to call a trusted driver.

kb.title: Pets and children policy
kb.body:
Pets
Pets are not allowed in the rooms or restaurants. Service animals are welcome with advance notice. We can recommend a nearby pet hotel.

Children
Children under 6 stay free in existing beds. An extra bed costs Rp 350,000 per night and a baby cot is free. The kids club accepts ages 4 to 12, and parents must stay on site.

kb.title: Events and weddings guide
kb.body:
Weddings and private events
We host beach weddings for up to 80 guests. Packages start from Rp 85,000,000 and include decoration, a celebrant and a dinner. Please contact the events team at least 90 days ahead.

Private dinners
A private beach dinner for two can be arranged with 24 hours notice.

kb.title: Dress code and quiet hours
kb.body:
Dress code
Swimwear is for the pool and beach only. The Garden Restaurant is smart casual in the evening. Please wear a cover-up in the lobby.

Quiet hours
Quiet hours are 22:00 to 07:00. The beach club may play music until 23:00 on event days.
